title: GeoLibre 1.0
summary: GeoLibre 1.0 is an open-source geographic/geospatial platform for accessing and sharing free map and location data, marking its first stable release with 257 HN points indicating strong community interest.
problem_solved: Provides free, libre geographic data and mapping tools to democratize access to geospatial information.
why_valuable: Offers open-source alternatives to commercial mapping services, enabling developers and researchers to freely use and contribute geographic data.
